titulo_fr: Une correspondance formelle : Repérer les informations
intro: It interprets tone, purpose and nuances of a professional letter. Read the French first; open the translation when you want to check your understanding.

texto: It interprets tone, purpose and nuances of a professional letter. It distinguishes statements, evidence and reservations; it attributes each data to its source before making a conclusion.
Attention: Conventional formulas frame the exchange; conditional and nominalizations adjust courtesy and distance. In this fragment, «convention» means «convenio».

frases.fr: Madame, je reviens vers vous au sujet de la convention transmise le 3 mai, dont la date d'effet reste à confirmer.
frases.es: Señora: le escribo de nuevo en relación con el convenio enviado el 3 de mayo, cuya fecha de entrada en vigor aún está por confirmar.
frases.en: Madam, I am writing to you again about the agreement sent on 3 May, the date of which is still to be confirmed.

frases.fr: Afin de respecter l'échéance prévue, pourriez-vous nous indiquer si les annexes doivent être paraphées séparément ?
frases.es: Para respetar el plazo previsto, ¿podría indicarnos si los anexos deben rubricarse por separado?
frases.en: In order to meet the time limit, could you tell us whether the annexes should be initialled separately?
